description: This file defines a Colors class implementing ICollection, managing color entities including adding, retrieving, and deleting colors, with default color constants and database interactions.

classes.name: Colors
classes.description: A class managing color entities, providing methods for CRUD operations and querying colors.

methods.name: color
methods.description: Retrieves a color by its ID.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a color by its color code.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a color entity in the collection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a filtered list of all non-deleted colors.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of notes associated with a color.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a color exists by ID.
